title: cJSON Flaw Makes Architecture Part of Vulnerability Triage
caption:
CERT Polska confirms CVE-2026-16554 in cJSON 1.7.19 on 32-bit platforms. Triage requires verifying architecture, API paths, and data reachability to understand exposure.
